idea-plugin.name: LogSmith
idea-plugin.description: Shows which log format a .log file uses and how many lines matched — in a status line under the standard editor, with zero configuration. Recognises 12 log formats plus a plain-timestamp fallback, colours timestamps, threads and levels (ERROR red, WARN amber, DEBUG dim) without ever making rendering worse, says so plainly when no format matches, and lets you switch colouring off per file. The file stays a normal, fully editable text file.

action.text: Disable LogSmith highlighting for this file
action.description: Turn LogSmith colouring on or off for this file without restarting
